svg.title: Layout vs GarageGraph
svg.desc: Left: the Layout is the parsed YAML: places, types and facts, keyed by node id. Right: the GarageGraph is a search graph whose vertices are poses (node + heading) and whose edges are moves.

g.text: Scheduler::Scheduler(): each member is built from the previous one, once, at start-up. InitRetrievalHeadings() then caches a retrieval heading per parking node in gg_.

g.text: Both describe the same garage. The Layout answers questions about places (node ids, types, positions, bays). The GarageGraph answers questions about motion: its vertices are poses

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: (node + heading) and its edges are the moves between them. Searches and paths always run on gg_.
